mapper.select: SELECT c.credential_id credentialId, c.tenant_id tenantId, c.key_prefix keyPrefix, c.key_verifier_phc keyVerifierPhc, c.expires_time expiresTime, c.status, t.tenant_type tenantType, t.owner_ref_id ownerRefId, t.owner_status ownerStatus, t.security_status securityStatus, c.version credentialVersion, t.version tenantVersion FROM t_api_credential c LEFT JOIN t_access_tenant t ON t.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE c.key_prefix=#{keyPrefix} AND BINARY c.key_prefix=BINARY #{keyPrefix} ORDER BY c.credential_id LIMIT #{limit}
